newsitem.title: USA: Middle Bay to acquire Shore Oil.
newsitem.headline: Middle Bay to acquire Shore Oil.

text.p: LOS ANGELES, June 25 (Reuter) Middle Bay Oil Co Inc Wednesday announced plans to acquire Shore Oil, a privately held domestic exploration and production company with oil and gas properties in Louisiana, Texas, Alabama and Mississippi.
In a statement, the companies said the merger will add proven reserves of 954,000 barrels of oil and natural gas liquids and 5,471 million cubic feet (Mmcf) of natural gas.

Under terms of the merger, Middle Bay will issue 1,883,333 shares of common stock, pay cash consideration of $200,000 and repay certain Shore indebtedness of $2,333,303 and assume bank debt of $2,105,000. In addition, it will issue 266,667 shares of preferred stock which are convertible into as many as 1,333,333 shares of common stock over the next five years contingent upon the results of drilling on Shore's mineral acreage.
Closing is expected to be no later than June 30, 1997.
